steps: 确认 Google 账号
打开手机上的 Google Play，点击右上角头像，确认当前邮箱。请用这个邮箱报名；Google 账号不一定是 Gmail 邮箱。
填写申请，等待邀请
提交本页表单后，站长会整理名单。测试版本和名单就绪后，加入链接与使用说明会发到报名邮箱，请留意垃圾邮件。此时还没有开始计算 14 天。
打开邀请，成为测试者
收到封闭测试邀请后，用报名时的同一个 Google 账号打开邀请链接，点击“成为测试者 / Become a tester”。页面显示你已成为测试者后，才算加入封闭测试。若之前加入了内部测试，需要先退出内部测试，再加入此次封闭测试。
从 Google Play 安装
在加入成功页面点击 Google Play 下载入口，确认商店右上角还是同一个账号，再安装或更新月读空间。安装后按应用内引导设置；聊天服务尚未配置时，可以先测试页面、阅读和 Live2D。
实际体验，持续参与 14 天
从成功加入封闭测试起，连续保持测试资格至少 14 天，期间在不同日期实际体验并反馈。没有固定每日打卡或好评任务。可以随时退出；退出再加入后，连续参与时间需要重新累计。
faqs: 报名后没有收到邀请？
提交表单只是登记申请。站长需要把邮箱加入测试名单，并确认版本可用；名单和链接的更改也可能需要数小时生效。请先检查邮箱拼写和垃圾邮件，再联系下方邮箱。
提示“不符合资格”或找不到应用？
先核对浏览器和 Play 商店是否都登录报名邮箱。封闭测试通常不能直接搜索到，请从邀请链接进入；仍无法加入时，将页面提示、设备型号和所在国家/地区告知站长。不要提交密码、验证码或 API 密钥。
已经安装官网 APK，可以参加吗？
可以申请，但仍需通过 Google Play 链接成为测试者并从商店安装测试版本。仅安装 APK 不计入封闭测试。如果提示签名或安装冲突，先备份本地数据并联系站长，不要贸然卸载。
聊天没有回复，或需要配置模型？
按应用内首次使用引导配置你选择的聊天服务；服务是否收费以提供方为准。遇到配置问题也可以反馈，不必为参加测试购买服务。先测试能使用的功能即可，不要在反馈里附上密钥。
怎么修改邮箱或删除申请？
请用报名邮箱联系 redchenk919@gmail.com，说明需要修改或删除。站长核验后处理。网站申请资料与 Google Play 的测试资格分别管理，删除申请不会自动退出 Google Play 测试。

steps: Check your Google account
Open Google Play on your Android device, tap your profile picture and check the email. Apply with this account; it does not have to be a Gmail address.
Apply and wait for an invitation

Submit the form on this page. Once the release and tester list are ready, the administrator will email your joining link and setup instructions. Check spam too. The 14-day period has not started at this step.
Open the invitation and opt in

After receiving a closed-test invitation, open it while signed in to the same Google account and choose “Become a tester”. You have joined only once Google confirms it. If you previously joined internal testing, leave that track before joining this closed test.
Install through Google Play

Follow the Google Play download link on the confirmation page, check the account again, then install or update Tsukuyomi Space. Follow the in-app setup guide. You can test navigation, reading and Live2D before configuring a chat service.
Use the app and stay opted in for 14 days

Remain opted in continuously for at least 14 days from joining. Use the app on different days and share real feedback. There is no fixed daily check-in or positive-review task. You may leave at any time; leaving and rejoining restarts the continuous period.
faqs: No invitation yet?

The form registers your application. Your email still needs to be added to the tester list and the release made available. Google changes can take several hours. Check your email spelling and spam folder, then contact us below.
Not eligible or app not found?

Check that the browser and Play Store both use your registered email. Enter through the invitation instead of searching. If it still fails, send the error, device model and country/region. Never send passwords, verification codes or API keys.
Already installed the website APK?

You can apply, but must still opt in through the Google Play link and install the test version from the store. Sideloading alone does not count. If there is a signing or installation conflict, back up local data and contact us before uninstalling.
Chat needs configuration or does not reply?

Follow the in-app guide to configure your chosen chat service. Provider charges may apply, but you do not need to buy a service to participate. Report setup problems and test the features available to you; never include keys in feedback.
How do I correct or delete my application?

Contact redchenk919@gmail.com from your registered email to request a correction or deletion. The administrator will verify and handle it. Website records and Google Play membership are separate; deleting your application does not opt you out of Google Play.
